content: ML on financial time series: random train/test splits leak via temporal autocorrelation and overlapping samples - walk-forward/expanding-window validation is mandatory; labels must be defined relative to trade horizons (fixed-horizon returns produce regime-dependent label distributions); class imbalance is typical (few high-quality setups) so use scale_pos_weight or focal-style weighting and evaluate with PR-AUC not accuracy; features computed from indicators that repaint leak future info; overfitting to a single backtest period is the default failure mode - evaluate across regimes and symbols.
